Within the first 90 days, complete at least three ACH credits or direct deposits into the account.
Within the same 90 days, complete at least ten point-of-sale transactions.
Keep the account open until the bonus is paid.
Receive the $400 bonus after all activities are completed (the official page gives no tighter payment window).
